name: Polish village fiddle
lineage: Eastern European folk-music tradition of rural Poland — characterized by single-fiddle or fiddle-and-drum (bęben obręczowy) lead with characteristic regional repertoires including the Tatra Górale (highlanders), Kurpie (northeastern), Beskid, Podlasie, and Mazowsze styles — preserved continuously through village-based wedding and ceremonial-occasion performance and documented through the twentieth-century ethnomusicological field-recording campaign
recipe: classic Eastern European early-1940s polish village fiddle, drone Modal, string branch, Slavic bard ballad poetry. double stops fiddle. wooden barn. large-diaphragm condenser, German V72 tube pre, German tube console, vari-mu, passive program EQ. tape 15ips plate reverb.
